message: variable `{name}` is read before it is assigned
description: On the path the model takes at this point, the variable is read before any statement has given it a value. This simulator does not give variables a starting value, so it reports the read rather than guess one.
actions: Assign the variable before it is read, on every path: for example `x = 0.0;` at the start of the analog block.
If it is assigned in one arm of an `if`, assign it in the other arm too.
